decisions.reason: After surviving its first full review with no visible sign of underperformance, this close-to-core carpet is likely still near aspiration and a growing market gives enough slack to retain it.

Its premium hand-knotted wool-silk positioning remains a good fit with the firm's craftsmanship-led identity, so absent clear evidence of a shortfall management would likely continue it despite niche-demand risk.

Portfolio overlap with other carpets keeps pruning risk somewhat elevated, but because it was retained through 2024 and no clear failure is visible, it is still more likely to stay on the market than be withdrawn.

As a close-to-core chair line with several models and broad application across customer groups, it likely offers stronger learning and sales potential and therefore remains the least likely of these products to be dropped.
